summary: Frontend-only validation of iteration 4 changes on https://metalworks-hub-12.preview.emergentagent.com . (1) WHITE-SCREEN NAV FIX verified: navigated Home->About->Services->Careers->Contact->Home via header links; sampled body text length every 100ms for 800ms after each click — zero intervals with <50 chars of text on ANY route (blank_intervals_in_800ms = 0/8 for all 5 transitions). No sustained white screen. (2) EXPLODED TOOL scroll animation verified: the 5 plates' CSS transforms change with scroll. At ~5% scroll inside the 300vh section, plate transforms were translateY(-125.7,-62.8,0,62.8,125.7) giving a vertical spread of 251.3px; at ~60% scroll the transforms reached the design max translateY(-270,-135,0,135,270) for a spread of 540.0px. Reversibility verified: scrolling back up dropped spread back to 211.8px (<540 -30 threshold). (3) Heading 'Every die, broken down to precision.' present. Progress bar fills (style.width went from 0% near start to ~95.76% deep in section) and state label updated ASSEMBLED -> DISASSEMBLING -> EXPLODED VIEW with scroll. (4) ABOUT director photos: all 5 director portraits load with naturalWidth=450, naturalHeight=562, complete=true and correct alt text (PIRABA GURUMURTHI, INDAR MUDALIAR, NANCY KIRKPATRICK, RANDY DUIVESTEYN, VLADIMIR POSATSKIY); visual screenshot confirms real photographs (Randy and Vladimir clearly visible as real human portraits). CEO ceo.png also loads (naturalWidth=800) — per agent_to_agent_context_note the CEO is an intentional placeholder, treated as expected. (5) Regression on Home: hero-services-btn, hero-stat-0, home-service-tooling card, and 'Trusted by' marquee (Ford visible) all render after adding ExplodedTool. Console: only React Router v6 -> v7 future-flag warnings (not errors); zero JS errors / page errors across all routes.
critical_code_review_comments: ExplodedTool state label uses useTransform with a 3-point string array ['ASSEMBLED','DISASSEMBLING','EXPLODED VIEW']; framer-motion snaps between discrete strings at the midpoint of each segment, so 'ASSEMBLED' is only visible at progress < 0.25. With the spring (stiffness 90, damping 24, mass 0.4) applied on top of useScroll, even small initial scrolls push progress past 0.25 quickly — the user may rarely see 'ASSEMBLED'. Consider widening the range to ['ASSEMBLED','ASSEMBLED','DISASSEMBLING','EXPLODED VIEW','EXPLODED VIEW'] with breakpoints [0, 0.15, 0.5, 0.85, 1] for a clearer initial state.

Director image filename 'NANCY KIRKPATRICK.png' contains a space (URL-encoded as %20) — still flagged from iteration 3, not yet renamed. Works but fragile across deploy targets; rename to NANCY.png to match siblings (PIRABA.png, INDAR.png, RANDY.png, VLADIMIR.png).

Images are served from /src/assets/images/*.png at runtime. In production Vite build these should go through the import + hashed-asset pipeline (the About.jsx imports from ../assets/images/<NAME>.png so Vite handles this — confirmed working). Just noting: do not move these images out of src/assets/ or the import paths will break.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 acceptance criteria all pass on the preview URL. ExplodedTool: section data-testid='exploded-tool-section', 300vh tall, sticky inner is 100vh; plate transforms can be read at section selector + '.absolute.inset-0.flex.items-center.justify-center' (5 nodes). To trigger lenis-friendly scrolling, use page.mouse.wheel(0, 500) in a loop with ~120ms waits and a 600-1500ms settle window before reading transforms — window.scrollTo alone is fine for early checks but lenis can fight it. Director images load via Vite at /src/assets/images/{PIRABA,INDAR,NANCY%20KIRKPATRICK,RANDY,VLADIMIR}.png with naturalWidth=450. CEO ceo.png placeholder is expected.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — every acceptance criterion in the review_request passed.
